properties.NAME: Annex 2 (prop)
properties.CHANGE: Legislature authorized VALLEY to annex territory from IDAHO, dependent on a vote in the general election of November 1920. No evidence the vote ever took place, proposed annexation failed.
properties.CITATION: (Id. Laws 1919, 15th sess., ch. 101/pp. 366-367; Id. Code Ann. (1996), vol. 6, ch. 1, sec. 31-145 "Valley Co."/pp. 56-57)
